trigger.target_selection_rule: Use the two frozen r27 folds whose candidate set contains next_forcing and whose IRG cell abstains with candidate_probe_coverage_incomplete; do not inspect target-local effect signs.

materialized_primitive_contract.actual_runtime_semantics: Adds bounded supervised latent prefix-window auxiliary losses through the existing training_loss path.
materialized_primitive_contract.explicit_non_claim: The materialized primitive does not train on model-generated rollouts; the probe diagnoses cross-prefix exposure sensitivity as a mechanistic proxy and must not be described as direct generated-rollout training.

smoke_gate.expansion_rule: Expand to the frozen eight-environment pilot only if runtime and receipt checks pass, at least one target environment passes locality, and the candidate is not redundant with self_rollout_latest_feedback on all locality-admitted target comparisons.

selection_rationale: The cumulative primitive-probe affinity marks next_forcing as probe_missing and requires multi_chunk_exposure_stability.
The frozen r27 replay identifies exactly cloth_move and reacher as IRG folds with next_forcing candidate coverage incomplete.

The new path applies piecewise prefix-chunk recovery, which is algebraically distinct from the existing latest-state-only feedback path while preserving the same checkpoint, evaluator, seeds, dose frame, and autoregressive mode.
The probe and its claims are aligned to the actual supervised prefix-window runtime proxy; no generated-rollout training behavior is claimed.
post_collection_rule: If the smoke gate admits expansion, collect the remaining six environments under the same campaign, build the atlas, replace only next_forcing's required path in a cumulative affinity, and rerun the unchanged selector plan, effect-label index, transfer certificate, and collision labels.
claim_boundary: This stage tests whether piecewise multi-prefix recovery supplies a nonredundant local diagnostic direction for the implemented next_forcing proxy. It is not model-improvement evidence and cannot by itself establish selector superiority or transfer safety.
